plugins.name: project-scaffold
plugins.description: Scaffold new projects from a strict engineering directory contract (CLAUDE.md map, ID registers, RTM) and enforce correct file placement for every artifact afterwards, including a PreToolUse hook that blocks illegal writes.

plugins.name: animated-deck
plugins.description: Build a self-contained, animated single-file HTML presentation deck — scales to any screen, keyboard/click/swipe nav, animated content + SVG node-edge diagrams, PDF export, and on-brand theming from a .pptx/.potx template. Bundles the deck template(s) and diagram/animation references.

plugins.name: graphviz-ai
plugins.description: Guide + tooling for the graphviz_master AI integration and a strict-layout diagram mode. Bundles the graphviz-ai skill: DotGenerator, LayoutPlanner, VisionClient, validation pipeline, and a hand-routed SVG generator (straight/orthogonal arrows, no overlaps, centered ports, hop bridges at crossings) with an R1-R9 rule audit (incl. min_font 14 readable-text floor), declarative alignment, high-res PNG export (--scale), and native-shape PowerPoint export (spec_to_pptx.py).
